findings.text: The test writes out its own copies of the omitted-module list and the export roots (`Proofs.migrationCorrect`, …) as literals, instead of using `EXPORT_ROOTS` and `PROTECTED_BASE_MODULE` from `migration_check/prepare.py`; the attack exports can therefore drift from what preparation actually exports. Fix: import `EXPORT_ROOTS` and `PROTECTED_BASE_MODULE` from `migration_check.prepare`, and build the omitted set and header `trusted_imports` the same way `export_bundle` does.

The docstring of `test_hostile_header` mentions only the candidate-import case, but the test also covers a missing bundle version, another bundle version and an invalid `trusted_imports` type. Fix: say that the checker rejects each malformed header, including a header that tries to import a candidate module as trusted.
